points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 84ccf50 clean CMake build succeeded in isolated cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB/network disabled; CTest registered no tests. Metadata revision is configure-time cached, not a production binary identifier.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:345–459 implements solve, partition and meshinfo; README:180–187 documents reproduction and bad-path handling. Clean compilation verified; no evaluator CFD run.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case, mesh, partition, solver, driver and output modules provide extension boundaries; solver.cpp still couples 2-D fluid details to the state.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Source and repository evidence reviewed for this scope; no copied solver core was established. This is not an external authorship or exhaustive license investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case.h loads case JSON and main invokes general solve path; driver.cpp:495–535 has an optional diagnostic fixed 20-cell ring perturbation. Its use in selected production is not established.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp:271–332 root-only setup uses METIS; solver.cpp:500–526 uses depth-two ghost stencil. README rank sensitivity and session5_notes:705–714 leave exact matched np4 binary/result comparison unresolved.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:697–716 bounds reconstructed primitives; driver.cpp detects nonfinite residuals. M2 production success labels nevertheless accept unstable force histories, and optional fixed ring perturbation is mesh specific.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean build passed; CTest found no registered tests. Contestant session5_notes:503–507 reports two selftests; no evaluator CFD execution or independent solver validation was performed.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source is modular and report/figure assets are tracked in 84ccf50; raw selected history files are original-workspace evidence, not found at the same checkpoint paths.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex equations/nondimensionalization and solver.cpp conservative flux/stress implement compressible 2-D gas; source uses constant case viscosity, with Sutherland limitation disclosed.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:94 onward reads CGNS multizone geometry; partition.cpp:289–332 constructs graph/METIS. Geometry generality and exact production binary remain limited by evidence.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:733–802 uses canonical face orientation, convective and viscous signs and adds adjacent-cell contributions. Numerical invariance across all rank/configuration combinations remains unproven.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:153–168,186–227 contains Roe/Harten-Yee and LLF fallback; transient LLF selection is documented. M2 cases show important stability limits.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:250–307 implements characteristic farfield; wall treatment and boundary-state output are described in report.tex:573 onward. No independent wall-row re-run was performed.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:520–526,627–660 computes least-squares gradients and limiter with ghost stencils; report.tex:793–798 explicitly discloses first-order M2 overrides and transient frozen limiter.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:592 onward limits gradients and :697–716 clips face primitives with positive floors. Overrides in M2 substantially suppress second order; no blanket DQ10 is inferred when disclosed.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:734 onward uses face-averaged velocity/temperature gradients and Newtonian flux; :1431–1495 removes normal traction from the stated tangential shear force. Report admits constant viscosity limitation.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: driver.cpp steady loop uses LU-SGS inner iterations and target plus optional residual plateau; M2 laminar stops with force still rapidly changing, so residual-only success is not physical convergence.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: driver.cpp:476–482,602–679 retains BDF2 histories, evaluates spatial-plus-time residual and checks inner target. Report/session document 281115f Re200 build lineage but no executable hash; no transient rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only METIS partition and depth-two ghost stencils in partition.cpp/solver.cpp; report.tex:1638–1670 gives Re20 and M080 rank comparisons. A reported np4 divergent diagnostic remains unbound and unquantified against a matched final state.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Output packages and report were structurally accepted by prior examiner; M2 success statuses contradict their force evidence, so correct file layout is not valid convergence.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior examiner evidence reports structural pass; it cannot determine physical convergence or identify the false success labels. No new evaluator CFD run.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M2 inviscid periodic and four-step M2 laminar converged labels are unsupported by their submitted force figures. Re200 reaches t300 but report discloses no resolved vortex street.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M2 inviscid irregular lift and laminar Cd1.913 still falling; Re200 weak non-street signal. Remaining steady cases have distinct force-window evidence in case notes; np4 M2 divergence lacks matched binary proof.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: 30-page compiled report includes per-case fields and force/residual figures. Re200 full-history force scale hides both late components; several steady plots compress startup-to-tail detail.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report documents first-order M2 controls and absent Re200 street, but calls physically unsettled M2 outputs successful. Re200 late force plot is unreadable; report text supplies numeric and drifting frequency estimates.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report figure manifest and committed figure assets exist; original workspace selected CSVs were not found at corresponding checkpoint paths and revision stamp is cached. No unverified binary-source link assumed.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean archive build passes; CLI/status schema documented and prior structural validation passes. CTest has no registered tests; runtime revision stamp is cached.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS multi-zone mesh and boundary input, geometry, adjacency and root-only METIS partition in mesh.cpp/partition.cpp; broader geometry not independently validated.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: solver.cpp assembles oriented conservative face flux, Roe/LLF, characteristic farfield and wall flux; numerical physical limitations remain documented.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Least-squares reconstruction, BJ limiter and positivity clipping present; M2 production first-order overrides explicitly disclosed; smooth-order evidence remains limited.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian stress, temperature gradients and tangential viscous force projection present; report discloses constant viscosity and force limitations.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Implicit LU-SGS and BDF2 history/inner-target checks implemented; M2 source uses a restricted CFL/first-order override and Re200 production binary has documented but not hashed lineage.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root setup METIS, neighbor ghost stencils and global reductions; report provides rank comparisons but session5_notes:705–714 records an np4 divergent M2 diagnostic without a matched output/binary comparison.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M2 inviscid and laminar falsely successful; Re200 reaches t300 without the required resolved street. Four other NACA cases and Re20 have independently reviewed histories and differing limitations; rank comparisons supplied.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Complete 30-page report with equations, contours and manifest; late Re200 lift/drag unreadable, M2 success claims inconsistent with forces, and raw figure-source history binding incomplete.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Modular case, mesh, solver, driver and output; physics and geometry remain substantially two-dimensional.

flags.text: MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
flags.evidence: Previous evidence README:180–187 says pinned-CFL M2 configuration is ordering-sensitive at np4 but gives no quantified controlled difference. Report.tex:1638–1670 instead presents Re20 and M080 laminar np1/np8 differences of 2.8% and 0.3% in Cd at different stopping steps. No controlled order-one case established; additional binary/control attribution remains open.

flags.text: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: M2 laminar metadata marks converged/completed after four steps while immutable 84ccf50:solver/report/figures/fig_naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000_forces.png shows Cd falling 13.6824→1.9131; immutable README:180–187 documents this as the production result. M2 inviscid metadata marks statistically_periodic/completed after 200 steps despite residual growth 0.945 orders and the submitted force figure showing irregular Cl about −0.8..0.9; report.tex:1690–1696 acknowledges floor artifacts. TASK.md:140,172 require genuine convergence or justified stable forces. Original workspace history hashes and runtime-binary limitation are in the ledger.

limitations: No evaluator clean build or MPI rerun.
M2 laminar production is first-order in 18353/20816 cells and rank-ordering sensitive.
Re200 was not rerun and report admits unresolved street quality.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
